zh: 雷丁大学（University of Reading）成立于1892年，位于英国英格兰伯克郡雷丁市，是一所具有悠久历史的研究型大学，在2026年QS世界大学排名中位列全球第194位，英国第27位，稳居世界前200强之列。学校在农业与林业学领域英国第1、全球前20，气象学全球顶尖，地球与海洋科学全球第49位。亨利商学院获AACSB、AMBA、EQUIS三重认证（全球仅1%商学院），拥有英国最大金融行为实验室。
en: The University of Reading, founded in 1892, is located in Reading, Berkshire, England, UK. It is a research-based university with a long history, ranked 194th in the QS World University Rankings 2026 and 27th in the UK, steadily maintaining its position among the world's top 200 universities. The university ranks 1st in the UK and top 20 globally in Agriculture & Forestry, with world-class Meteorology and 49th globally in Earth & Marine Sciences. Henley Business School holds triple accreditation (AACSB, AMBA, EQUIS) - only 1% of business schools worldwide achieve this - and houses the UK's largest financial behavior laboratory.

address.zh: 英国英格兰伯克郡雷丁市
